rationale: Price is at 97.6% of today's range and within $0.06 of the session high after a strong intraday recovery from the gap-down open, leaving minimal upside before hitting resistance at today's high ($54.80) with only 86 minutes to close. The last five 1-minute candles show stalling momentum with declining volume and a slight fade from the high, suggesting exhaustion rather than a clean breakout setup. A short against the high is risky given the positive news catalyst and strong relative volume supporting buyers; a long here offers an unfavorable risk/reward with the stop needing to be placed below the 9-EMA ($54.65) for only ~$0.06 of potential gain to the high.
